candidate_breakdown.q1_text: Hi my name is Dias and I want join inVision U because I think this kind of program is where student can really test himself, not only collect certificate and say nice words. I want be in place where I need think, solve problems, communicate with people, maybe fail also, and then learn from this. I am not best presenter maybe, but in real work I stay serious and practical.
candidate_breakdown.q2_text: Program I am most interested is entrepreneurship and innovation because for me this is not only business for money. It is about seeing problem and making workable solution. I got interested in this when I joined one student initiative and I saw many ideas die not because they are stupid, but because nobody structure them and nobody take process seriously. I want improve exactly this skill.
candidate_breakdown.q3_text: Major challenge I overcame was when I was leading part of student event and one week before date two important people leave the team. At that moment I felt stress a lot because if nobody reorganize, event will fail and many people already expected it. First idea in my head was just do everything myself, but then I understand this is bad decision. So I split work into smaller urgent tasks, made short meeting, asked each person choose one responsibility they can really finish, and I took communication with speakers on myself. What helped me was trying stay practical and not lose time in panic. Event was not perfect in end, but it happened well and participants gave good feedback.
candidate_breakdown.q4_text: My long term goal is build projects that improve opportunities for students, maybe in education technology or youth development. I still don't know exact title of future work, but I know I want role where I combine management, problem solving, and social value. This program can help me because I need stronger tools, not only motivation. What motivates me is progress and usefulness, when I see work creates something bigger than myself.
candidate_breakdown.q5_text: Leadership for me means taking responsibility for direction and energy of group when situation becomes uncertain. It also means making decisions without ignoring people. I remember one team discussion where people argued too much about small details and all energy was going away. I said first we need agree on main goal, then separate urgent things from not urgent things. After that discussion became calmer and more focused. I think that was leadership because I did not only speak loud, I helped group move.
candidate_breakdown.q6_text: Yes my family supports me. Biggest source of encouragement is my father because he always says if I see chance to grow, I should not choose comfort too early.
